limitations.0: Only encodes/decodes the 5 core HTML entities
limitations.1: Does not encode numeric entities like < or named entities like

faq.question: Which characters are encoded?
faq.answer: The tool encodes the 5 HTML special characters: & < > " '.

faq.question: Why encode HTML?
faq.answer: Encoding prevents HTML injection (XSS) by converting special characters to their entity equivalents.

csv-json-converter.name: CSV to JSON Converter
csv-json-converter.description: Convert CSV data to JSON objects and vice versa. Supports comma, semicolon, and tab delimiters.
csv-json-converter.longDescription: Transform flat CSV data into structured JSON arrays and back. Choose your delimiter. The first row is treated as headers when converting CSV to JSON. All processing happens locally in your browser.

limitations.0: CSV parsing does not handle quoted fields containing delimiters
limitations.1: JSON to CSV only works with arrays of flat objects

faq.question: How are CSV headers handled?
faq.answer: When converting CSV to JSON, the first row is used as object keys. Each subsequent row becomes an object with those keys.

faq.question: Can I use different delimiters?
faq.answer: Yes. You can choose between comma, semicolon, or tab as the delimiter.

xml-formatter.name: XML Formatter & Validator
xml-formatter.description: Format and beautify XML with proper indentation, or minify XML by removing whitespace. All client-side.
xml-formatter.longDescription: Parse raw XML and format it cleanly with standard tag indentation, or collapse everything into a minified string. All processing happens in your browser.

limitations.0: Formatting uses regex-based approach — may not handle all XML edge cases
limitations.1: Does not validate XML schema or DTD

faq.question: Does this validate XML?
faq.answer: The tool formats XML using regex-based parsing. It does not perform full XML schema validation.

faq.question: What does minify do?
faq.answer: Minify removes all unnecessary whitespace between tags, creating a compact single-line XML string.

css-minifier.name: CSS Minifier & Beautifier
css-minifier.description: Beautify CSS with clean indentation or minify by stripping comments, whitespace, and trailing semicolons.
css-minifier.longDescription: Optimize raw CSS with dual actions: Beautify and Minify. All processing happens locally in your browser.

limitations.0: Beautifier uses regex-based formatting — may not handle all CSS preprocessing syntax
limitations.1: Minifier removes all comments including important ones

faq.question: What does minify remove?
faq.answer: Minify removes all CSS comments, extra whitespace, and unnecessary semicolons/colons.

faq.question: Can this handle SCSS/SASS?
faq.answer: The tool is designed for standard CSS. SCSS/SASS-specific syntax may not be formatted correctly.

contrast-checker.name: Color Contrast Checker
contrast-checker.description: Check WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios between foreground and background colors. Shows Pass/Fail for AA and AAA.
contrast-checker.longDescription: Compute exact contrast ratio between foreground and background colors using standard WCAG 2.1 formulas. All calculations happen in your browser.

limitations.0: Only supports HEX color input
limitations.1: WCAG thresholds are based on the standard 2.1 specification

faq.question: What are the WCAG thresholds?
faq.answer: AA Normal: 4.5:1, AA Large: 3:1, AAA Normal: 7:1, AAA Large: 4.5:1.

faq.question: Why is contrast important?
faq.answer: Sufficient contrast ensures text is readable for users with visual impairments.

loan-calculator.name: Loan Calculator
loan-calculator.description: Calculate monthly payments, total interest, and total cost for loans. Enter principal, rate, and term.
loan-calculator.longDescription: Compute monthly repayments, total interest, and aggregate lifetime cost of loans. Uses the standard amortization formula. All calculations happen in your browser.

limitations.0: Uses fixed-rate amortization formula — does not support variable-rate loans
limitations.1: Does not account for fees, taxes, or insurance

faq.question: What formula is used?
faq.answer: The tool uses the standard amortization formula: M = P × (r(1+r)^n) / ((1+r)^n - 1).

faq.question: Does this include fees or taxes?
faq.answer: No. The calculator only computes principal and interest.

text-line-counter.name: Text Line Counter & Trimmer
text-line-counter.description: Count lines, trim whitespace, remove empty lines, and truncate lines by character count. All client-side.
text-line-counter.longDescription: Process multi-line text with multiple operations: count total lines, trim whitespace, remove empty lines, and truncate lines. All processing happens in your browser.

limitations.0: Truncation is by character count — does not consider word boundaries
limitations.1: Trim only removes leading/trailing whitespace, not internal spaces

faq.question: What does 'Trim' do?
faq.answer: Trim removes leading and trailing whitespace from each line. Internal spaces are preserved.

faq.question: How does 'Max chars per line' work?
faq.answer: When set to a value greater than 0, each line is truncated to that maximum character count.

cron-expression-generator.name: Cron Expression Generator
cron-expression-generator.description: Build cron schedule expressions visually with dropdown menus. Generates standard 5-part cron syntax with human-readable description.
cron-expression-generator.longDescription: Create cron expressions with an intuitive visual builder. Select minute, hour, day, month, and weekday values from dropdown menus. The tool generates the standard 5-part cron string and a human-readable description.

limitations.0: Only supports standard 5-part cron syntax
limitations.1: Does not support special characters like @daily or @reboot

faq.question: What is cron syntax?
faq.answer: Cron is a time-based job scheduler. The 5 fields are: minute (0-59), hour (0-23), day of month (1-31), month (1-12), and day of week (0-7).

faq.question: What does * mean in cron?
faq.answer: An asterisk (*) means 'every' — e.g., * in the minute field means every minute.

css-gradient-generator.name: CSS Gradient Generator
css-gradient-generator.description: Create beautiful CSS gradients visually. Linear and radial modes, multi-color stops, angle control, live preview.
css-gradient-generator.longDescription: Design modern CSS gradients with an interactive visual editor. Choose linear or radial gradients, add up to 3 color stops, adjust the angle.

limitations.0: Supports up to 3 color stops
limitations.1: Does not support conic gradients

faq.question: What gradient types are supported?
faq.answer: Linear gradients (with adjustable angle) and radial gradients (circle shape).

faq.question: Can I use more than 3 colors?
faq.answer: The current version supports up to 3 color stops. You can manually edit the generated CSS for more.

sales-tax-calculator.name: Sales Tax / VAT Calculator
sales-tax-calculator.description: Calculate net, tax, and gross amounts. Supports tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive modes.
sales-tax-calculator.longDescription: Compute sales tax or VAT with flexible modes. Enter an amount and tax rate, then choose tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive.

limitations.0: Uses a single flat tax rate
limitations.1: Does not account for tax exemptions or reduced rates

faq.question: What is the difference between tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive?
faq.answer: Tax-exclusive means the tax is added on top. Tax-inclusive means the entered amount already includes the tax.

faq.question: Can I use multiple tax rates?
faq.answer: No. The calculator supports a single flat tax rate.

random-choice-picker.name: Random Choice Picker
random-choice-picker.description: Enter choices and let the tool pick one randomly. Simple decision helper with spinning animation.
random-choice-picker.longDescription: A decision helper tool. Enter your choices, click pick, and the tool randomly selects a winner with a spinning animation.

limitations.0: Uses Math.random() — not cryptographically secure
limitations.1: Choices must be separated by commas or new lines

faq.question: How are choices separated?
faq.answer: Choices can be separated by commas or new lines. Empty entries are filtered out.

faq.question: Is the selection truly random?
faq.answer: The tool uses Math.random() for selection, suitable for casual decision-making.

css-box-shadow-generator.name: CSS Box Shadow Generator
css-box-shadow-generator.description: Create CSS box-shadow rules visually with sliders. Control offsets, blur, spread, color, opacity, and inset.
css-box-shadow-generator.longDescription: Design CSS box-shadow effects with an interactive slider editor. Adjust all shadow properties and see a live preview.

limitations.0: Generates a single box-shadow layer
limitations.1: Color opacity is controlled separately from the color picker

faq.question: Can I create multiple shadows?
faq.answer: The tool generates a single box-shadow. For layered shadows, manually combine multiple definitions.

faq.question: What does inset do?
faq.answer: Inset creates an inner shadow that appears inside the element's border.

data-size-converter.name: Data Size Unit Converter
data-size-converter.description: Convert between bits, bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB, and PB. Supports base-2 (1024) and base-10 (1000) conversions.
data-size-converter.longDescription: Convert data size units instantly. Toggle between base-2 and base-10 conversions. All calculations in your browser.

limitations.0: Only supports integer bit/byte multiples
limitations.1: Petabyte results may show in exponential notation

faq.question: What is the difference between base-2 and base-10?
faq.answer: Base-2 uses 1024 (KiB). Base-10 uses 1000 (kB). Storage manufacturers use base-10, OS often uses base-2.

faq.question: What units are supported?
faq.answer: Bits (b), Bytes (B), KB, MB, GB, TB, and PB.

temperature-converter.name: Temperature Converter
temperature-converter.description: Convert between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin in real time. All fields update simultaneously.
temperature-converter.longDescription: Convert temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin instantly. Type in any field and all others update.

limitations.0: Only supports Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin

faq.question: What formulas are used?
faq.answer: Fahrenheit = Celsius × 9/5 + 32. Kelvin = Celsius + 273.15.

faq.question: Can I convert negative temperatures?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool handles negative values correctly. 0K is absolute zero.

length-converter.name: Length & Distance Converter
length-converter.description: Convert between metric and imperial length units: mm, cm, m, km, inches, feet, yards, and miles.
length-converter.longDescription: Convert length and distance measurements across metric and imperial units. Enter a value in any unit and see all equivalents.

limitations.0: Does not support nautical miles or light-year units
limitations.1: Precision may vary for very large or very small values

faq.question: What units are supported?
faq.answer: Millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards, and miles.

faq.question: Are the conversions exact?
faq.answer: Yes. All conversions use exact conversion factors (e.g., 1 inch = 25.4mm).

weight-converter.name: Weight & Mass Converter
weight-converter.description: Convert between milligrams, grams, kilograms, tons, ounces, pounds, and stones. Real-time multi-unit display.
weight-converter.longDescription: Convert weight and mass measurements across metric and imperial units. Enter a value in any unit and see all equivalents.

limitations.0: Uses metric tons (tonnes) — US short tons are not supported
limitations.1: Very small values may display in exponential notation

faq.question: What units are supported?
faq.answer: Milligrams, grams, kilograms, metric tons, ounces, pounds, and stones.

faq.question: Is the ton metric or imperial?
faq.answer: The tool uses metric tons (tonnes), where 1 ton = 1000 kg.

hex-base64-converter.name: HEX to Base64 Converter
hex-base64-converter.description: Convert hexadecimal strings to Base64 and vice versa. Includes validation for non-hex characters.
hex-base64-converter.longDescription: Convert between hexadecimal and Base64 formats. The tool validates input and flags non-hexadecimal characters.

limitations.0: Hex input must have even number of characters
limitations.1: Non-hex characters will produce an error

faq.question: What formats are accepted for hex input?
faq.answer: The tool accepts hex strings with or without 0x prefix, and with or without spaces.

faq.question: How does Base64 to hex work?
faq.answer: The Base64 string is decoded to raw bytes, then each byte is converted to its 2-digit hex representation.

unicode-inspector.name: Unicode Character Inspector
unicode-inspector.description: Inspect any character's Unicode code point, HTML entities, UTF-8 and UTF-16 encoding. Detailed character properties.
unicode-inspector.longDescription: Enter any text and inspect each character's Unicode properties: code point, decimal value, HTML entities, UTF-8 and UTF-16 encoding.

limitations.0: Does not show Unicode category or block name
limitations.1: Surrogate pairs are shown as individual UTF-16 units

faq.question: What is a code point?
faq.answer: A code point is a unique number assigned to each Unicode character, written as U+XXXX.

faq.question: How are emoji handled?
faq.answer: The tool uses codePointAt(0) which correctly handles surrogate pairs for emoji.

random-string-generator.name: Random String Generator
random-string-generator.description: Generate random strings with customizable length, character sets, and count. Block duplicate characters option.
random-string-generator.longDescription: Generate multiple random strings with full control: length, count, character sets, and optional no-duplicates mode.

limitations.0: Uses Math.random() — not cryptographically secure
limitations.1: Blocking duplicates limits maximum string length to charset size

faq.question: Is this suitable for passwords?
faq.answer: No. Use the Password Generator which uses the Web Crypto API for secure generation.

faq.question: What does 'Block duplicates' do?
faq.answer: When enabled, no character will appear more than once in each generated string.

ascii-art-generator.name: ASCII Art Text Generator
ascii-art-generator.description: Convert text into stylized ASCII art banners. Block font with copy-to-clipboard. All client-side.
ascii-art-generator.longDescription: Transform plain text into multi-line ASCII art banners using a block font made of Unicode block characters.

limitations.0: Only supports A-Z, 0-9, and space
limitations.1: Maximum input length is 20 characters

faq.question: What characters are supported?
faq.answer: The block font supports A-Z (uppercase), 0-9, and space. Lowercase is converted to uppercase.

faq.question: Can I use different fonts?
faq.answer: The current version includes one block font. Additional fonts may be added in future updates.

text-anonymizer.name: Text Anonymizer & PII Masker
text-anonymizer.description: Mask emails, phone numbers, and IP addresses in text. Privacy protection with toggleable redaction rules.
text-anonymizer.longDescription: Protect sensitive information in logs and text. The tool scans for emails, phone numbers, and IP addresses using regex and replaces them with redaction markers.

limitations.0: Phone number detection uses pattern matching — some formats may be missed
limitations.1: Email regex covers standard formats but not all edge cases

faq.question: What PII does the tool detect?
faq.answer: Emails, phone numbers (international and US formats), and IPv4 addresses. Each type can be toggled on or off.

faq.question: Is the redaction accurate?
faq.answer: The tool uses regex patterns. While it covers common formats, no regex is perfect. Verify for critical compliance use cases.

markdown-table-generator.name: Markdown Table Generator
markdown-table-generator.description: Create Markdown tables visually with an interactive grid editor. Adjustable rows, columns, and per-column alignment.
markdown-table-generator.longDescription: Build Markdown tables with an Excel-style grid editor. Set rows and columns, type content, choose alignment per column.

limitations.0: Maximum 20 rows and 10 columns
limitations.1: Does not support cell merging or complex formatting

faq.question: How do I set column alignment?
faq.answer: Each column header has a dropdown selector. Choose Left, Center, or Right.

faq.question: Can I add more rows or columns?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the Rows and Columns number inputs to resize. Existing data is preserved.

json-path-finder.name: JSON Path Finder
json-path-finder.description: Paste JSON and explore a searchable tree. Click any node to get its dot-notation path for easy access.
json-path-finder.longDescription: Navigate complex nested JSON structures with an interactive tree view. Click any leaf node to see and copy its dot-notation path.

limitations.0: Does not support JSONPath or jq-style queries
limitations.1: Very large JSON files may render slowly

faq.question: What format are paths in?
faq.answer: Paths use dot notation for object keys and bracket notation for array indices. Example: $.users[0].profile.name

faq.question: Can I copy the path?
faq.answer: Yes. Click any leaf node and the path appears with a copy button.

css-glassmorphism-studio.name: CSS Glassmorphism Studio
css-glassmorphism-studio.description: Create glassmorphism effects with backdrop-filter. Adjust blur, opacity, radius, tint, and shadow with live preview.
css-glassmorphism-studio.longDescription: Design modern glassmorphism (frosted glass) UI effects with an interactive editor. Control backdrop blur, opacity, radius, tint, and shadow.

limitations.0: backdrop-filter requires modern browser support
limitations.1: Effect may not render without content behind the element

faq.question: What is glassmorphism?
faq.answer: Glassmorphism uses backdrop-filter blur with semi-transparent backgrounds to create a frosted glass effect.

faq.question: Does backdrop-filter work in all browsers?
faq.answer: Most modern browsers support it. Safari requires the -webkit- prefix (included automatically).

css-clip-path-maker.name: CSS Clip-Path Maker
css-clip-path-maker.description: Create CSS clip-path polygons visually. Drag nodes, add points, and copy clip-path code with live preview.
css-clip-path-maker.longDescription: Design CSS clip-path polygons with an interactive visual editor. Drag nodes, add or remove points, and see the clipped result in real time.

limitations.0: Only supports polygon clip-path
limitations.1: Maximum 12 polygon points
limitations.2: Drag-and-drop may not work on touch devices

faq.question: What is clip-path?
faq.answer: The clip-path CSS property creates a clipping region that determines which parts of an element are visible.

faq.question: Can I use circle or ellipse clip-paths?
faq.answer: The current version only supports polygon clip-paths. Circle and ellipse may be added later.

colorblind-simulator.name: Colorblind Vision Simulator
colorblind-simulator.description: Simulate how colors appear to people with Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia. Includes WCAG contrast scores.
colorblind-simulator.longDescription: Test color combinations for accessibility. Pick foreground and background colors, then see how they appear under three types of color blindness.

limitations.0: Simulation is an approximation — actual perception varies
limitations.1: Does not cover anomalous trichromacy (partial color blindness)

faq.question: What are the three color blindness types?
faq.answer: Protanopia (red-blind), Deuteranopia (green-blind), and Tritanopia (blue-blind).

faq.question: Is the simulation accurate?
faq.answer: The simulation uses established transformation matrices. It provides a good approximation but cannot perfectly replicate individual perception.

social-meta-previewer.name: Social Media Meta Tags Previewer
social-meta-previewer.description: Preview how your website looks on Google, Facebook, Twitter/X, and Discord. Real-time social card mockups.
social-meta-previewer.longDescription: Enter your page title, description, site name, URL, and image URL to see real-time visual previews of how your link will appear when shared.

limitations.0: Previews are approximations — actual rendering may vary
limitations.1: Image is not loaded — only the URL is shown

faq.question: What meta tags do these previews correspond to?
faq.answer: Google uses title and meta description. Facebook uses og: tags. Twitter uses twitter: tags. Discord uses og: tags.

faq.question: Why doesn't the image show?
faq.answer: The tool shows a placeholder. In production, the actual image would be loaded from your og:image URL.

nginx-formatter.name: Nginx Config Beautifier
nginx-formatter.description: Format and beautify Nginx configuration files. Proper indentation for server, location, and proxy directives.
nginx-formatter.longDescription: Clean up messy Nginx config files with proper indentation. The formatter parses directives and aligns brackets for server, location, and other blocks.

limitations.0: Uses simple bracket-based indentation — does not validate syntax
limitations.1: Does not support inline comments within directives

faq.question: Does the formatter validate my Nginx config?
faq.answer: No. The tool only formats indentation. Use nginx -t to validate your config.

faq.question: Are comments preserved?
faq.answer: Yes. Lines starting with # are preserved without indentation changes.

csv-to-sql-converter.name: CSV to SQL INSERT Generator
csv-to-sql-converter.description: Convert CSV data into SQL INSERT statements. Custom table name, separator selection, and auto number detection.
csv-to-sql-converter.longDescription: Transform CSV data into ready-to-use SQL INSERT statements. Enter a table name, choose separator, paste CSV, and get formatted INSERT statements.

limitations.0: Auto-detects numbers using Number() — locale-specific formats may not work
limitations.1: Does not handle CSV values containing newlines within quoted fields

faq.question: How are numbers detected?
faq.answer: The tool uses Number() conversion. If a value converts to a valid number, it is inserted without quotes.

faq.question: Can I use a custom table name?
faq.answer: Yes. Enter the table name in the input field. The first row of your CSV is used as column names.

homoglyph-detector.name: Unicode Homoglyph Detector
homoglyph-detector.description: Detect lookalike Unicode characters in text. Phishing defense tool for identifying Cyrillic, Greek, and IPA homoglyphs.
homoglyph-detector.longDescription: Protect against phishing and punycode attacks. Paste a URL or text and the tool highlights hidden homoglyphs from different scripts.

limitations.0: Covers common Cyrillic, Greek, and IPA homoglyphs — not exhaustive
limitations.1: Does not check domain registration or SSL certificates

faq.question: What is a homoglyph?
faq.answer: A homoglyph is a character from one script that looks identical to a character from another script, like Cyrillic 'а' and Latin 'a'.

faq.question: How do homoglyph attacks work?
faq.answer: Attackers register domains using homoglyphs (e.g., 'аpple.com' with Cyrillic 'а'). The domain looks legitimate but resolves to a different server.

jwt-spoofing-simulator.name: JWT Payload Spoofing Simulator
jwt-spoofing-simulator.description: Educational tool: decode a JWT, edit its payload, and re-encode it. Includes security warning about signature verification.
jwt-spoofing-simulator.longDescription: An educational security tool for understanding JWT vulnerabilities. Paste a JWT, decode it, edit the payload, and see the re-encoded token with a security warning.

limitations.0: Only modifies the payload — the signature remains unchanged
limitations.1: Educational use only — do not use to attack real systems

faq.question: Will the modified token work?
faq.answer: No. The JWT signature is computed using the header and payload with a secret key. Changing the payload invalidates the signature.

faq.question: Why is this tool useful?
faq.answer: It demonstrates why JWT signature verification is critical. If a server fails to verify signatures, an attacker could escalate privileges.

svg-path-editor.name: SVG Path Visualizer & Editor
svg-path-editor.description: Paste SVG path data, render it on canvas, and inspect node coordinates. Copy path data instantly.
svg-path-editor.longDescription: Visualize and edit SVG path data interactively. Paste the d attribute of an SVG path, see it rendered on a canvas, inspect node coordinates.

limitations.0: Supports M, L, and Z path commands only
limitations.1: Does not support curves or interactive node dragging yet

faq.question: What path commands are supported?
faq.answer: Move (M), Line (L), and Close Path (Z). Curve commands are rendered but nodes are not parsed.

faq.question: Can I drag nodes?
faq.answer: The current version displays coordinates but does not support drag editing.

canvas-code-painter.name: HTML Canvas Code Painter
canvas-code-painter.description: Draw shapes on canvas and generate JavaScript Canvas 2D Context API code automatically.
canvas-code-painter.longDescription: An interactive canvas drawing tool that generates clean JavaScript code using the Canvas 2D Context API.

limitations.0: Rectangles are drawn by click-drag
limitations.1: Does not support gradients or complex paths in generated code

faq.question: How do I draw shapes?
faq.answer: Select a shape type, then click on the canvas. For rectangles and lines, click and drag.

faq.question: What code is generated?
faq.answer: Vanilla JavaScript using the Canvas 2D Context API (ctx.fillRect, ctx.arc, etc.).

css-animation-studio.name: CSS Animation Keyframes Studio
css-animation-studio.description: Create CSS @keyframes animations visually. Add color stops, set duration, preview live, and export code.
css-animation-studio.longDescription: Design CSS animations with a visual timeline editor. Add keyframe stops, choose properties, set duration, preview live.

limitations.0: Supports background-color and transform scale only
limitations.1: Maximum keyframe count is limited by UI

faq.question: What properties can I animate?
faq.answer: Background-color transitions and transform scale. More properties may be added.

faq.question: How do I add keyframe stops?
faq.answer: Click 'Add Keyframe', set the percentage and color for each stop.

cookie-explorer.name: Browser Cookie Explorer Sandbox
cookie-explorer.description: Read, create, and delete LocalStorage, SessionStorage, and cookies. Includes capacity visualization.
cookie-explorer.longDescription: A sandbox for exploring browser storage. View, add, and delete key-value pairs in LocalStorage, SessionStorage, and cookies.

limitations.0: Only accesses storage for the current domain
limitations.1: Cookie deletion depends on path and domain settings

faq.question: Is it safe to use?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool only reads and writes storage for the current website domain.

faq.question: Why can't I delete some cookies?
faq.answer: Cookies with specific path or domain restrictions may require matching attributes.

exif-location-plotter.name: EXIF Image Location Map Plotter
exif-location-plotter.description: Extract GPS coordinates from JPEG EXIF data and plot the photo location on an OpenStreetMap.
exif-location-plotter.longDescription: Upload a JPEG photo and the tool reads EXIF metadata locally, including GPS coordinates. If found, displays the capture point on a map.

limitations.0: Only supports JPEG files with EXIF data
limitations.1: Photos without GPS data show metadata only
limitations.2: HEIC and RAW are not supported

faq.question: Does the tool upload my photos?
faq.answer: No. All EXIF parsing happens in your browser.

faq.question: Why no GPS data?
faq.answer: GPS data requires location services to be enabled. Some apps strip EXIF for privacy.

audio-tag-reader.name: Audio ID3 Tag Reader
audio-tag-reader.description: Extract metadata from MP3 and M4A files. Read title, artist, album, year, genre, and track number.
audio-tag-reader.longDescription: Drag and drop an MP3 or M4A file to extract embedded metadata tags. Parses ID3v2 and M4A atoms locally.

limitations.0: Only supports MP3 (ID3v2) and M4A
limitations.1: Does not extract album cover art
limitations.2: Large files may take a moment

faq.question: What audio formats are supported?
faq.answer: MP3 with ID3v2 tags and M4A with iTunes-style atoms.

faq.question: Can I extract album art?
faq.answer: The current version extracts text metadata only. Album art may be added later.

unix-timestamp-converter.name: Unix Timestamp Converter
unix-timestamp-converter.description: Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa. Live clock with UTC, local, and ISO 8601 output.
unix-timestamp-converter.longDescription: A dual-directional Unix timestamp converter. Enter a numeric epoch timestamp to see UTC, local, and ISO 8601 representations.

limitations.0: Negative epochs may not display correctly in all browsers
limitations.1: Maximum date limited by JavaScript Date object

faq.question: What is a Unix timestamp?
faq.answer: The number of seconds since January 1, 1970 UTC (the Unix epoch).

faq.question: Does the tool support milliseconds?
faq.answer: The tool works with second-based timestamps. Divide by 1000 for millisecond timestamps.

base64-image-coder.name: Base64 Image Encoder & Decoder
base64-image-coder.description: Encode images to Base64 data URIs or decode Base64 strings back to downloadable images. All client-side.
base64-image-coder.longDescription: Dual-mode image Base64 tool. Upload an image to get its Base64 data URI, or paste Base64 to preview and download.

limitations.0: Large images produce very long Base64 strings
limitations.1: Decoding requires a valid Base64 string

faq.question: What is a Base64 data URI?
faq.answer: A string that embeds image data inline, formatted as data:image/png;base64,....

faq.question: Is there a file size limit?
faq.answer: The tool handles files up to your browser's memory limit. Very large images may cause performance issues.

hash-generator-engine.name: Hash Generator Engine (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512)
hash-generator-engine.description: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes simultaneously from text input. Uppercase toggle and one-click copy.
hash-generator-engine.longDescription: A unified cryptographic hash generator. Type or paste text and instantly get MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hash values.

limitations.0: MD5 is implemented in JavaScript for compatibility
limitations.1: MD5 and SHA-1 are cryptographically broken — use SHA-256 or SHA-512 for security

faq.question: Why are all four hashes shown at once?
faq.answer: Convenience. Each hash can be copied independently without switching tools.

faq.question: Is MD5 secure?
faq.answer: No. MD5 is cryptographically broken. Use SHA-256 or SHA-512 for security purposes.

robots-txt-tester.name: Robots.txt & Sitemap Tester
robots-txt-tester.description: Paste a robots.txt file and URLs to check which are blocked by Disallow rules. Includes sitemap detection.
robots-txt-tester.longDescription: Analyze robots.txt files for URL blocking rules. Paste content and URLs to test against Disallow and Allow rules.

limitations.0: Uses simplified pattern matching
limitations.1: Does not fetch remote robots.txt files

faq.question: How does Allow/Disallow precedence work?
faq.answer: More specific Allow rules can override broader Disallow rules.

faq.question: Can I test remote robots.txt files?
faq.answer: No. Paste the content manually for privacy and CORS reasons.

cron-explainer.name: Cron Schedule Explainer
cron-explainer.description: Paste a cron expression and get a human-readable explanation plus the next 5 execution times.
cron-explainer.longDescription: Decode cron expressions into plain language descriptions. Enter a 5-part cron expression and get a fluent explanation.

limitations.0: Supports standard 5-part cron expressions
limitations.1: Does not support @reboot or named schedules
limitations.2: Next execution times are approximate for complex expressions

faq.question: What format is supported?
faq.answer: Standard 5-part cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.

faq.question: How are next execution times calculated?
faq.answer: The tool iterates minute by minute from the current time, checking each field against the cron pattern.

font-glyphs-analyzer.name: Font Glyphs Analyzer
font-glyphs-analyzer.description: Upload TTF, WOFF, or WOFF2 fonts to inspect glyph count, supported scripts, and preview characters.
font-glyphs-analyzer.longDescription: A client-side font analysis tool. Drag and drop a font file and the tool parses it in-browser using opentype.js.

limitations.0: WOFF2 support depends on browser compatibility
limitations.1: Analysis only — does not perform font subsetting
limitations.2: Sample glyph grid shows up to 64 characters

faq.question: Does the tool upload my font files?
faq.answer: No. All font parsing happens in your browser using opentype.js.

faq.question: Can I subset fonts with this tool?
faq.answer: The current version analyzes and displays glyph information only. Subsetting may be added later.

qr-code-scanner.name: QR Code Scanner
qr-code-scanner.description: Scan QR codes from uploaded images or live camera feed. Decodes entirely in-browser with copy support.
qr-code-scanner.longDescription: A client-side QR code scanner with two modes. Upload an image or use your camera for real-time scanning using jsQR.

limitations.0: Camera access requires HTTPS or localhost
limitations.1: Low-quality or small QR codes may not be detected
limitations.2: Camera mode requires user permission

faq.question: Does the tool work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. All scanning happens in your browser. Camera requires HTTPS or localhost.

faq.question: Why can't it detect my QR code?
faq.answer: Ensure the QR code is well-lit, centered, and fills a good portion of the image.
